Let $E$ be the set of edges in a graph $G=(V, E)$.
A decomposition is a partition of $E$ into subsets $P_1, P_2, \dots, P_k$.
Each $P_i$ is either:

$|E| = \sum_{i=1}^c |C_i| + e$.

Since each cycle has length at least 3, $|C_i| \ge 3$.
Thus, $|E| \ge 3c + e$.
We want to minimize $k = c + e$.
